name: Review Summary
summary: Read-only aggregate rating, review count, and optional target-supplied rating distribution.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Self-contained native figure for the read-only aggregate and optional distribution.

anatomy.name: average
anatomy.description: Required native figcaption containing the visible exact aggregate score, canonical Rating composition, and review count.

anatomy.name: score
anatomy.description: Visible, target-formatted exact aggregate score hidden from the accessibility tree because canonical Rating owns the target-projected accessible star value.

anatomy.name: rating
anatomy.description: Required canonical Rating composition and single accessible owner of the target-supplied half-step star projection.

anatomy.name: bars
anatomy.description: Optional labelled native list of target-supplied rating-distribution rows.

anatomy.name: barRow
anatomy.description: Native list item for one target-defined rating bucket.

anatomy.name: barTrack
anatomy.description: Passive visual track for one distribution value.

anatomy.name: barFill
anatomy.description: Passive visual fill whose width is supplied by the target.

anatomy.name: barCount
anatomy.description: Visible target-formatted count for one rating bucket.

properties.name: ratingValue
properties.description: Aggregate rating value supplied by the target; the contract does not define how it is calculated.

properties.name: ratingDisplayValue
properties.description: Target-supplied half-step projection passed to canonical Rating; it remains explicit and may differ from the exact aggregate rather than being rounded by neutral code.

properties.name: ratingLabel
properties.description: Accessible aggregate-rating text, such as 4.5 out of 5 stars.

properties.name: reviewCount
properties.description: Total review count supplied by the target; the contract does not synchronize or aggregate records.

properties.name: reviewCountLabel
properties.description: Visible target-formatted review count, including any surrounding label.

properties.name: distribution
properties.description: Optional target-owned rating-distribution rows with visible bucket labels and counts.

properties.name: distributionLabel
properties.description: Localized accessible name applied when the optional distribution list is rendered.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Responsive summary that stacks when available inline space is narrow.

states.name: withoutDistribution
states.description: Default passive aggregate with no distribution list.

states.name: withDistribution
states.description: Passive aggregate followed by a labelled target-supplied distribution list.

behavior.name: readOnlyAggregate
behavior.description: The summary displays supplied values only; calculation, moderation, filtering, and synchronization remain target responsibilities.

behavior.name: canonicalRatingComposition
behavior.description: The composed canonical Rating is the single accessible owner of the target-projected half-step value and scale; neutral code never rounds the exact aggregate into that projection.

behavior.name: distributionText
behavior.description: Every supplied distribution width has equivalent visible bucket and count text.

behavior.name: intrinsicResponsiveLayout
behavior.description: The average and optional distribution wrap from split to stacked presentation according to the component's available inline size without viewport state or source reordering.

behavior.name: passiveCore
behavior.description: The neutral component owns no event, focus, controlled state, live announcement, transition, observer, request, or runtime calculation.

accessibility: Expose the aggregate score and total as readable text rather than only stars or bar widths.
Use one canonical Rating accessible label that includes the target-projected value and scale; do not repeat it on the figure root or visible score.
Render the optional distribution as a labelled list; every bar needs visible bucket and count text and cannot rely on width or color alone.
Keep the passive figure out of the focus order and do not announce aggregate data as a live region unless the consuming target owns a separate update requirement.
Preserve source order, readable text, separator visibility, and track/fill distinction in narrow containers, RTL, forced colors, and CSS-disabled contexts.

web.notes: Native figure, figcaption and list semantics plus intrinsic component-width wrapping are implemented in components/css/reviews.css; aggregate and distribution data remain target supplied.

shopify.notes: Copied CSS is target-ready, but a future Liquid projection must select a truthful review provider or data model, locale labels, scale and distribution without adding neutral JavaScript or changing this passive display contract.
